mapper.select: SELECT user_id, id AS login_id, name, pw_hash, birth_date, phone_number, invite_code, subscription, status, profile_photo, role_no, created_at, updated_at FROM "user" WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "user" (id, pw_hash, name, birth_date, phone_number, invite_code, subscription, status, profile_photo, role_no, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{pwHash}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{phoneNumber}, #{inviteCode}, #{subscription}, #{status}, #{profilePhoto}, #{roleNo}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE "user" SET id = #{id}, pw_hash = #{pwHash}, name = #{name}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, invite_code = #{inviteCode}, subscription = #{subscription}, status = #{status}, profile_photo = #{profilePhoto}, role_no = #{roleNo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
